description: You are debugging a Node.js API service with a flaky integration test. The test in 'tests/integration/api_test.js' randomly fails with timeout errors approximately 30% of the time. The test makes 10 concurrent requests to the API endpoint. Your task is to: (1) Add diagnostic instrumentation (console.log statements with timestamps) to 'lib/database.js' to expose timing and connection pool state (at least 5 log statements showing timestamps, queue length, or active connections), (2) Run the test multiple times using 'npm test' in the integrated terminal to observe the behavior, (3) Create a file named 'DEBUGGING_NOTES.md' in the workspace root (/home/ga/workspace/api_service/) documenting your findings. The documentation must include: (a) description of observed behavior, (b) suspected root cause (related to concurrency, connection pool, race condition, or async timing), (c) evidence from logs (paste relevant log snippets), and (d) at least 200 characters of content. Do NOT fix the bug, only investigate and document it. Save all modified files when done.
